articles.summary: Case files rarely arrive in the right shape. Extra tabs, subtotal rows, closed accounts, one row per transaction when you need one case per customer. With Agentic Upload, Bretton AI creates cases from the CSV or Excel files your team already receives. Tell the agent how to read the file, and it sorts every row into Ready, Needs input or Excluded, with a reason for each exclusion. Nothing is created until your team reviews and approves. A $3 billion commercial bank now turns its weekly check fraud referral file into cases this way, without reformatting it first. Agentic Upload is available on every Bretton AI agent. [link]
articles.title: Introducing Agentic Upload

articles.summary: Workflows links Bretton AI agents into one investigation. Each outcome picks the next step, and the next agent picks up the earlier work: findings, documents, narrative and analyst notes. Your analysts confirm every hand-off, and the full review stays in one record from the first alert to the final decision. Contact your Bretton AI team to set up your first workflow.
